Phase summaries of a fit on new data

Source: R/predict.R
phase_summaries.Rd

Evaluates the shared C++ model at every draw on the rows of newdata.

Usage

phase_summaries(fit, newdata, draws)

Arguments

fit

A phase_fit object

newdata

Data frame with id, time and the model's covariates; the outcome is needed only for the outcome-conditional summaries

draws

Matrix of parameter draws (one row per draw)

Value

List of arrays indexed [draw, row of newdata, phase]: mean (the outcome mean of each phase, on the response scale), marginal (the phase probability given the covariates), predictive (given the unit's earlier outcomes), filtered (given the unit's outcomes up to and including the row) and move (the probability of moving from each phase to the next at the row), plus sigma ([draw, phase], the residual SDs), family (the family code of each phase) and has_response
